classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the pole as opposite and the wire as hypotenuse in the supplied triangle, then apply inverse sine and round to minutes.

content.prompt:
A 4.5 m flagpole has a 5.6 m wire anchored into the ground.
Calculate the angle that the wire makes with the ground to the nearest minute.

spec.description: Vertical pole, sloping wire, dashed ground, right-angle marker and interior theta. The two source side-labelling regions are supplied as editable native clozes associated with the pole and wire below the figure.
spec.mathematics: Pole and ground are perpendicular; the wire is the hypotenuse. Lengths remain in the stem and are responses in the labelling clozes.
spec.answerVisibility: Side-labelling responses and the angle result are hidden in the student edition.
